name: Authentication & Logons
description: Successful logons (4624), failed logons (4625), explicit credentials (4648), special privileges (4672) & logoffs (4634, 4647)
sql: Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4624, 4625, 4634, 4647, 4648, 4672)

name: Brute Force & Password Spraying
description: Failed logons (4625), account lockouts (4740), Kerberos pre-auth failures (4771), and NTLM validation failures (4776)
sql: Channel = 'Security' AND (TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4625, 4740, 4771) OR (TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 4776 AND concat_ws(' ', *COLUMNS(lambda c: c ILIKE 'Payload%' OR c ILIKE 'MapDescription' OR c ILIKE 'ExecutableInfo' OR c ILIKE 'Channel')) ILIKE '%0xC000%'))

name: Kerberoasting, AS-REP & Pass-the-Hash
description: Kerberos TGT/TGS ticket requests (4768, 4769), RC4 downgrade (0x17), and Pass-the-Hash NTLM Type 3/9 logons (4624)
sql: Channel = 'Security' AND (TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4768, 4769, 4770, 4771) OR (TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 4624 AND regexp_matches(concat_ws(' ', *COLUMNS(lambda c: c ILIKE 'Payload%' OR c ILIKE 'MapDescription' OR c ILIKE 'ExecutableInfo' OR c ILIKE 'Channel')), 'NtLmSsp|Logon ?Type[^0-9]*9([^0-9]|$)', 'i')))

name: RDP & Remote Desktop Sessions
description: RDP auth (1149), LocalSessionManager session logon/reconnect/disconnect (21-25), RDP client (1024, 1102), and Type 10 logons (4624, 4778, 4779)
sql: (Channel ILIKE '%TerminalServices%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 39, 40, 1024, 1102, 1149)) OR (Channel = 'Security' AND (TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4778, 4779) OR (TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 4624 AND regexp_matches(concat_ws(' ', *COLUMNS(lambda c: c ILIKE 'Payload%' OR c ILIKE 'MapDescription' OR c ILIKE 'ExecutableInfo' OR c ILIKE 'Channel')), 'Logon ?Type[^0-9]*10([^0-9]|$)', 'i'))))

name: SMB, Admin Shares & WinRM Lateral Movement
description: Network share access (5140, 5145), outbound explicit creds (4648), SMBClient connectivity (30803), and WinRM WSMan shells (6, 91, 168)
sql: (Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (5140, 5145, 5142, 4648)) OR (Channel ILIKE '%WinRM%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (6, 91, 168)) OR (Channel ILIKE '%SMB%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (30803))

name: PowerShell & Script Host Execution
description: ScriptBlock logging (4104), module/pipeline execution (4103), engine start/stop (400, 403), and command execution (800)
sql: Channel ILIKE '%PowerShell%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4103, 4104, 4100, 400, 403, 600, 800)

name: Process Creation & Sysmon Telemetry
description: Security process creation (4688), process exit (4689), and Sysmon process/network/DLL/injection events (1, 3, 7, 8, 10, 11, 22)
sql: (Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4688, 4689)) OR (Channel ILIKE '%Sysmon%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (1, 3, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 22))

name: Services & Scheduled Task Persistence
description: New service installed (7045, 4697), service state/type change (7036, 7040), and Scheduled Task creation/update (4698-4702, 106, 140, 200)
sql: (Channel = 'System' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (7045, 7036, 7040, 7034)) OR (Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4697, 4698, 4699, 4700, 4701, 4702)) OR (Channel ILIKE '%TaskScheduler%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (106, 140, 141, 200, 201))

name: WMI Persistence & Remote WMI Activity
description: WMI EventFilter, EventConsumer, and FilterToConsumerBinding creation (19, 20, 21, 5861) and WMI execution fail/activity (5857, 5858, 5860)
sql: (Channel ILIKE '%WMI-Activity%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (5857, 5858, 5859, 5860, 5861)) OR (Channel ILIKE '%Sysmon%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (19, 20, 21))

name: BITS Jobs & Background Payload Transfers
description: Background Intelligent Transfer Service job creation (3), transfer completion (4), and remote URL downloads (59, 60, 61)
sql: (Channel ILIKE '%Bits-Client%' OR COALESCE(Provider, '') ILIKE '%Bits%') AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (3, 4, 59, 60, 61, 16403)

name: Account Management & Privilege Escalation
description: User created/enabled/deleted (4720, 4722, 4726), password reset (4724), and admin group modifications (4728, 4732, 4756, 4738)
sql: Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4720, 4722, 4723, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4728, 4732, 4733, 4738, 4756)

name: Windows Defender & Endpoint Detections
description: Malware detected (1006, 1116), remediation action (1007, 1117), failure (1118, 1119), real-time protection disabled (5001), exclusions added (5007)
sql: (Channel ILIKE '%Defender%' OR COALESCE(Provider, '') ILIKE '%Defender%') AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (1006, 1007, 1008, 1116, 1117, 1118, 1119, 2000, 5001, 5004, 5007, 5013)

name: Log Clearing, Clock Tampering & Anti-Forensics
description: Security audit log cleared (1102), System log cleared (104), audit policy modified (4719), and system time changed (4616)
sql: (Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (1102, 4719, 4616, 1100)) OR (Channel = 'System' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 104)

name: Shadow Copy (VSS) & Ransomware Indicators
description: Volume Shadow Copy service stop/errors (7036, 8222) and VSS backup deletion events
sql: (Channel IN ('Application', 'System') AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (8222, 8193, 8194)) OR (Channel ILIKE '%Backup%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (524, 753)) OR (((Channel = 'System' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 7036) OR (Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 4688) OR (Channel ILIKE '%Sysmon%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 1) OR (Channel ILIKE '%PowerShell%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4103, 4104, 800))) AND regexp_matches(concat_ws(' ', *COLUMNS(lambda c: c ILIKE 'Payload%' OR c ILIKE 'MapDescription' OR c ILIKE 'ExecutableInfo' OR c ILIKE 'Channel')), CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 7036 THEN '(Shadow.*Cop|VSS).*stopped|stopped.*(Shadow.*Cop|VSS)' ELSE 'vssadmin|shadowstorage|shadow.*cop.*delet|wbadmin.*delet|bcdedit.*recoveryenabled' END, 'i'))

name: Windows Firewall Rules & Port Openings
description: Firewall rule added/modified/deleted (2004, 2005, 2006, 2033, 4946, 4947, 4948) and firewall profile disabled (2003)
sql: (Channel ILIKE '%Firewall%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2033)) OR (Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (4946, 4947, 4948))

name: USB & External Storage Mounts
description: Partition table/volume mount events (1006), PnP device installation (400, 410), and DriverFrameworks USB insertion (2003-2102)
sql: (Channel = 'Security' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 6416) OR (Channel ILIKE '%Partition%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) = 1006) OR (Channel ILIKE '%DriverFrameworks%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (2003, 2004, 2005, 2010, 2100, 2102)) OR (Channel ILIKE '%Kernel-PnP%' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (400, 410, 420))

name: Application Crashes, WER & MSI Installations
description: Application crashes/faults (1000), Windows Error Reporting (1001), and MsiInstaller package installations (1033, 1040, 11707, 11724)
sql: Channel = 'Application' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (1000, 1001, 1033, 1034, 1040, 11707, 11724)

name: System Boot, Shutdown & Unexpected Reboots
description: Kernel boot (12), clean shutdown (13), dirty shutdown (41), user-initiated restart/shutdown (1074), and EventLog service start/stop (6005, 6006, 6008)
sql: Channel = 'System' AND TRY_CAST(EventId AS BIGINT) IN (12, 13, 41, 1074, 6005, 6006, 6008, 6009)
